title: FIFO Full Flag Off-By-One (Early Assertion)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [OVERFLOW] Data written with full=1 but count=DEPTH-1; slot wasted and next write drops data
rtl:
assign full  = (count == DEPTH - 1);  // Asserts one cycle early
assign empty = (count == 0);
expected_root_cause: The full flag comparison uses DEPTH-1 instead of DEPTH, causing full to assert when one empty slot remains; the final slot is permanently inaccessible and data silently dropped.
fix_replacement:
assign full  = (count == DEPTH);  // Correct: assert only when truly full
assign empty = (count == 0);
description: The full flag uses count == DEPTH-1, asserting one entry too early; the FIFO has one unused slot and a write after full asserted silently drops data.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [OVERFLOW] Data written with full=1 but count=DEPTH-1; slot wasted and next write drops data
success_log: full asserts at count=DEPTH. All 16 slots filled before full fires.
